rules.text: Surfaces are cream panels / plates / chips with an ink outline; no dark navy or slate plates, boxes or loading screens
Two text kinds only: dark ink on cream, white with outline on colour or the world; never text on studs
One green main button per screen, every other button grey, red only for the X
Rarity colours only on rarity things (cards, rarity words, hatch rays)
Real art only: no code-drawn icons, stand-ins or empty boxes
One font and the 28/20/16/14 scale; kid copy (no 36.4000%, no 5m 0s)
Windows: stud frame, glossy header in the place colour, X inside the strip; the hatch is a full stage, not a window
Everything sits inside its screen/window; nothing clipped, floating outside or overlapping
